description.description: A human-readable explanation of what the property does.

required.description: Whether this property is required for connection to succeed.

secret.description: Whether this property is a secret.

possibleValues.description: List of allowed values for this property, if applicable.

category.description: Logical category this property belongs to (e.g., "OAuth", "Connection").

value.description:
An optional expression (e.g., "existInJdbcPropertyContext()") that computes the final value
for this property. If present, this will always override any existing value, including user-provided ones.

default.description:
An optional expression (e.g., "secretKey()") that provides a fallback default value
to be used only if no value is supplied by the user or other logic.

delete.description:
An optional expression (e.g., "shouldDelete()") that evaluates
whether this property should be excluded from the final configuration.

urlOnly.description: Whether this property should be placed in the JDBC url only.

name: SqlEngine.PropertyInfo
